name: Recall
description: Search the user own documents and your past conversations with them. This is their private material - notes, contracts, manuals, code - indexed on this machine. Use it BEFORE web search whenever a question sounds like it concerns something of theirs, and use search_chats when they refer to something discussed before that you cannot see.
